objective: Mitigate PGRST303 JWT-future authentication failures and prevent permission-snapshot fallback request storms without changing authorization, exams or production infrastructure
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: canonical main e78f8f6a31f17a63641c72cb341f2b6bd3692049 inspected October 29, 2026; live BUKLOD Connect Supabase project yhanxndaqbmuzbdqlblu has elevated REST 401 with PGRST303. Android production bundle/OTA source not reverified; DEV only.
acceptanceChecks: Only exact PostgREST PGRST303 JWT issued at future REST 401 is replayed, after a delay, once per client-wide cooldown
Writes retry only when PostgREST itself rejected JWT before execution; functions, Auth endpoints, uploads and unrelated 401s are never replayed
Permission snapshot JWT 401 is shared without fan-out to the individual permission RPCs
Ordinary permission 404 still delegates to authoritative RPC and no permission is granted on client failure
No exam/Quiz code, migration, service key, native runtime or production deployment altered
Provider-side clock mismatch remains a separate live incident and must be verified recovered before production release
